distribution.summary: 福建；湖南；江西；四川；云南
distribution.narrative: 殷蕙芬等 (1984) records Fujian and Sichuan under Xyleborus adumbratus. 黄复生等 (2015) adds Hunan and Yunnan under the same historical name. Smith et al. (2020), using current name Xyleborus pfeilii, records Fujian, Hunan, Jiangxi, Sichuan and Yunnan, adding Jiangxi.

host_note: Current host synthesis follows 殷蕙芬等 (1984)/黄复生等 (2015); Smith et al. (2020) contributes distribution evidence only in the promoted record.
taxonomy_summary: The current accepted identity is Xyleborus pfeilii (Ratzeburg, 1837).
